commands: set -e; EXPECTED=c8652aa6eaaf23c07b809c44b0ae98b3c435c555; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; echo '=== ADB DEVICES ==='; adb devices -l; SERIAL=$(python3 -c 'from scripts.s22_call_control import Adb; print(Adb().serial)'); echo selected_serial=$SERIAL; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk >/dev/null; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" status; APK=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge | cut -d: -f2 | head -n1); test -n "$APK"; set +e; OUTPUT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.CallAssistantAudioProbe construct" 2>&1); RC=$?; set -e; echo "$OUTPUT"; echo probe_exit=$RC; echo offcall_call_assistant_complete=true
